mem0.positioning: Persistent memory for developers and applications
mem0.distribution: Self-service entry, developer documentation and enterprise trust links
mem0.lesson: Put a usable integration example close to the main benefit. Keep source, status and trust information discoverable.
mem0.visual_review: Large clear headline, restrained light canvas and visible code example. Reviewed desktop screenshot only.

zep.lesson: Explain control and deployment choices after the benefit. Show a product view, with its evidence status made clear.
zep.visual_review: Editorial headline beside a product screenshot, clear primary and secondary actions. Reviewed desktop screenshot only.

supermemory.distribution: Developer console, setup prompt, sales and self-hosting documentation
supermemory.lesson: Make setup reusable and copyable, but keep secret values out of generated configuration.
supermemory.visual_review: Persistent sidebar and compact technical presentation. Copy-setup control sits beside the main action. Reviewed desktop screenshot only.

cognee.positioning: Open-source memory and shared company knowledge
cognee.distribution: Developer sign-up plus company deployment and case-study routes
cognee.lesson: Separate a developer quickstart from organization-wide adoption. Case-study links do not independently establish customer results.
cognee.visual_review: Not visually reviewed; headings and visible links were inspected.

honcho.distribution: Developer start, quickstart, benchmark source and founder contact
honcho.lesson: Make benchmark methodology and a short first integration easy to find. Do not reuse the vendor's performance claims.
honcho.visual_review: Not visually reviewed; headings and visible links were inspected.

memos.distribution: Open-source repository, quickstart, pricing and documentation
memos.lesson: Offer an explicit local path and distinguish it from hosted billing and account setup.
memos.visual_review: Not visually reviewed; headings and visible links were inspected.

hindsight.distribution: Documentation-first entry with quickstart, integrations and template hub
hindsight.lesson: A reference product can succeed through runnable documentation without a large marketing homepage.
hindsight.visual_review: Not visually reviewed; headings and visible links were inspected.

senselab.distribution: Repeated free-start action leading to a signed-out application
senselab.lesson: Use a short connection sequence and a legible product preview. Do not treat public learning claims or customer counts as independently verified.
senselab.visual_review: Bright background, centered benefit, two clear actions and a product preview. Reviewed desktop screenshot only; authenticated onboarding was not tested.

letta.distribution: Research, product and open-source organization links
letta.lesson: The organization homepage is not the whole product. Follow its product documentation before marking a feature absent.
letta.visual_review: Not visually reviewed; headings and visible links were inspected.

synth.distribution: Project-start action, quickstart and cloud research sign-up
synth.lesson: Offer a task-shaped starting point. Use usesynth.ai, not the unrelated synth.ai domain.
synth.visual_review: Not visually reviewed; headings and visible links were inspected.

tellurio.lesson: Explain the relationship between product names so a documentation handoff does not look like an unrelated service.
tellurio.visual_review: Not visually reviewed; headings and visible links were inspected.

langwatch.positioning: Simulation, evaluation and observability for complex agents
langwatch.lesson: Make a checkable result visible. Describe evaluation separately from production task success.
langwatch.visual_review: Task/problem headline with a visible evaluation panel. A 390-pixel overflow was observed; cause and cross-device impact were not investigated.

notdiamond.distribution: Pricing, developer documentation, login and demonstration booking
notdiamond.lesson: Tie efficiency to a complete measured route. Our product still needs evidence of task-level savings, not only lower retrieval latency.
notdiamond.visual_review: Not visually reviewed; headings and visible links were inspected.

typesafe.lesson: Describe a decision engine as a selectable provider. Published speed and price comparisons do not qualify our adapter or a user's workload.
typesafe.visual_review: Not visually reviewed; headings and visible links were inspected.

prismml.lesson: Do not score a research/model project as if it must have subscription checkout or a workflow dashboard.
prismml.visual_review: Not visually reviewed; headings and visible links were inspected.

osmosis.lesson: Services-led adoption needs a different comparison from self-service developer software.
osmosis.visual_review: Not visually reviewed; headings and visible links were inspected.

adaptive.positioning: Model adaptation, evaluation and production optimization
adaptive.lesson: Keep offline experiments, production comparisons and promotion controls visible as separate responsibilities.
adaptive.visual_review: Not visually reviewed; headings and visible links were inspected.

distyl.positioning: Enterprise transformation and applied AI systems
distyl.lesson: Customer outcomes can explain value better than component counts. We need our own qualified examples before publishing equivalent claims.
distyl.visual_review: Not visually reviewed; headings and visible links were inspected.

tensorzero.lesson: A sparse homepage is not evidence about every repository capability. The historical archive claim needs its own dated repository evidence.
tensorzero.visual_review: Not visually reviewed; headings and visible links were inspected.

stripe.distribution: Client-specific setup, access management and action confirmation
stripe.lesson: Show the supported configuration, credential boundary and how to verify or revoke a connection together.
stripe.visual_review: Stable navigation, readable code blocks and client tabs. A 390-pixel overflow was observed; this is not a full accessibility assessment.

n8n.distribution: Self-service, sales, integrations and customer stories
n8n.lesson: Explain reusable workflows with a concrete task and inspectable execution. Do not imply equivalent integration breadth before it exists.
n8n.visual_review: Strong primary action and workflow-led copy. Its dark campaign design is not our requested light direction. Reviewed desktop screenshot only.

retool.distribution: Self-service, sales, templates and customer stories
retool.lesson: Make useful examples and governance documentation reachable from the same journey.
retool.visual_review: Not visually reviewed; headings and visible links were inspected.

resend.distribution: Documentation, test mode, examples and self-service access
resend.lesson: A small working first example is more useful than a catalogue of unverified integration logos.
resend.visual_review: Not visually reviewed; headings and visible links were inspected.

baltor.positioning: Reusable solutions through scoped steps, suitable models and reusable intelligence
baltor.distribution: Invited pilot; public registration and live charging are not open
baltor.lesson: Close native connection, useful task evidence and account onboarding gaps before making broad superiority or savings claims.
baltor.visual_review: Light benefit-led homepage with a labelled workflow illustration. Current screenshots precede this cycle's guided-connection deployment.
